landing.heading: Moderation
landing.subtitle: Reports, content and sign-ups waiting for a decision.
landing.screensEmpty: No moderation screen is available to you yet
landing.screensEmptyDescription: Screens appear here as they are added.

common.gone: This content cannot be read: it was removed or you may not see it.

errors.id: That is not a valid record.
errors.state: Choose one of the offered states.
errors.type: That kind of content cannot be handled here.
errors.signupsTooMany: A decision takes at most {count} sign-ups at a time.
errors.signupsDays: Enter a number of days from 1 to 3650, or ban for good.
errors.signupsPassword: Enter your password to delete the accounts.

noticeFields.reasonHelp: Kept with the action in the moderator log.
noticeFields.notifyHelp: Tell the member this action concerns.

reports.heading: Reports
reports.subtitle: Reported content, newest first. You see the reports on content you may handle.
reports.others: and {count, plural, one {# other} other {# others}}

case.heading: Report case {id}
case.contentDescription: As the site stores it, with the pictures your Data saver settings allow.
case.historyDescription: The backend keeps the state, who holds the case and when it changed; it does not keep a list of past changes.
case.linksDescription: Content and members are handled where they live.
case.messageHelp: Direct messages open through an audited view.
case.formDescription: Change the state of the case, with a note.
case.stateHelp: Assigning gives you the case. Resolved and rejected close it.

auditedRead.heading: This view is logged
auditedRead.warning: Direct messages are not open to moderators. Opening this message shows it with the messages around it, and the moderator log records that you did, with your name and the time. Open it only to decide this case.
auditedRead.viewDescription: The message under review is marked. The view was logged.
auditedRead.empty: The direct message has no messages to show.

approvals.heading: Approvals
approvals.subtitle: Content waiting for approval, newest first. You see what you may approve.

review.heading: Review: {type} {id}
review.contentDescription: As submitted, with the pictures your Data saver settings allow.
review.notWaiting: This content is no longer waiting for approval; the backend decides whether it may still be changed.
review.approveDescription: Makes the content visible to everyone who can see its place.
review.rejectDescription: Deletes the content. Everyone but those who may see deleted content stops seeing it.

ips.heading: IP addresses
ips.subtitle: Find the members who used an address, or see every address one member used. IPv6 addresses are grouped by their /64 network.
ips.addressHelp: An IPv4 or IPv6 address, or an IPv6 network written like 2001:db8:1:2::/64.
ips.invalid: That is not an IPv4 or IPv6 address.
ips.membersEmptyDescription: Failed sign-ins are not counted, and nothing is logged for actions from before the log began.
ips.memberRefused: You cannot see this member's addresses: they rank at or above you, or do not exist.
ips.memberEmptyDescription: Nothing has been logged for this member yet.

signups.heading: Sign-ups
signups.subtitle: New accounts waiting for approval, newest first. Until you approve one, the member reads the forum like a guest and cannot write. An account is listed once it has confirmed its email.
signups.emptyDescription: New accounts appear here when the site approves sign-ups by hand.
signups.emailHidden: hidden: you do not manage this account
signups.sharedCount: {accounts, plural, one {# other account} other {# other accounts}}{banned, plural, =0 {} other {, # banned}}
signups.selected: {count, plural, one {# sign-up selected} other {# sign-ups selected}}

reject.warning: The member is emailed the reason, if you give one.

modeHelp.ban: Keeps the account, with the address it signed up from and its record of the terms, which the queue shows for the next account. It stays closed for good, or held out of the queue until the ban ends.
modeHelp.delete: Removes the account together with the address it signed up from and its record of the terms. It cannot be undone and asks for your password.

reject.banLimited: {count, plural, one {Your bans are limited to # day, so this is a ban of # day.} other {Your bans are limited to # days, so this is a ban of # days.}} The account returns to the queue when it ends.
reject.banForeverNote: A ban for good closes the account: it leaves the queue and stays closed.
reject.banTimedNote: While the ban runs the account is held and out of the queue. When it ends the account returns to the queue, with a new alert to staff. The member has already been told it was rejected.

result.approve: {done, plural, one {# sign-up approved} other {# sign-ups approved}}{skipped, plural, =0 {} other {, # skipped}}{failed, plural, =0 {} other {, # failed}}.
result.reject: {done, plural, one {# sign-up rejected} other {# sign-ups rejected}}{skipped, plural, =0 {} other {, # skipped}}{failed, plural, =0 {} other {, # failed}}.
result.more: {count, plural, one {# more is not listed.} other {# more are not listed.}}

signups.stoppedBulk: The erasure of at least one ticked sign-up stopped part way. Only deleting the accounts can finish it, so approving and banning are not offered.
